tip.jaymospowers.arsenal.title: Pocket Arsenal
tip.jaymospowers.arsenal:
Sneak + %1$s marks a place. Hold Sneak + %2$s for the places menu.
Hold %3$s: Blade Storm. Hold the cannon key: a battery of cannons.
tip.jaymospowers.chrono.title: Chronokinesis
tip.jaymospowers.chrono:
Downed, press %1$s within 3 seconds to rewind to your feet.
Sneak + %5$s once ascended: Time Stop.
Hold attack bare-fisted during Overclock for a flurry.
tip.jaymospowers.cryo.title: Cryokinesis
tip.jaymospowers.cryo:
%1$s toggles the Ice Slide: W pushes off, Sprint is faster, S brakes.
Sprint + %3$s throws an Ice Javelin that flies straight.
tip.jaymospowers.darktide.title: Darktide
tip.jaymospowers.darktide:
Hold right click to guard; raise it just as a blow lands to parry.
Hold %1$s to charge a Dark Strike, let go to strike.
tip.jaymospowers.gravity.title: Gravity
tip.jaymospowers.gravity:
Hold %1$s to Lift. Right click chokes then slams; left click pushes.
Tap %4$s to force kneel, hold it for a Gravity Wave.
Hold %3$s: ride a slab of rock.
tip.jaymospowers.resonance.title: Resonance
tip.jaymospowers.resonance:
Hold %2$s at a block to hum it apart.
Hold %4$s instead of tapping it: Quiet, no sound at all.
Ascended, in the dark, Sneak + %3$s: Sky Sight.
tip.jaymospowers.smoke.title: Smoke
tip.jaymospowers.smoke:
%1$s turns your legs to smoke: Sprint to cruise, S to brake.
Shift in Vapour Form, fully mastered: all smoke.
Sneak + the skill key: Smoke Step into your own cloud.
tip.jaymospowers.web.title: Web Slinger
tip.jaymospowers.web:
Sneak + %5$s with every ability: Web Blossom, leap and web every foe in sight.
The attack key (%7$s) whirls a single line.
%8$s with Webbed Fists in hand raises the web shield: three hits, no knockback.
tip.jaymospowers.wind.title: Wind Control
tip.jaymospowers.wind:
Stormbound: hold %7$s under rain to draw charge from the sky; %8$s hurls a hammer (sneak switches the throw).
%9$s calls a bound weapon back (sneak: bind); %10$s clashes two together.
%11$s then jump: storm landing. Sneak + %12$s marks a road home.
tip.jaymospowers.xenoform.title: Xeno-Band
tip.jaymospowers.xenoform:
Hold %6$s and scroll to turn the dial, let go to slam the band.
As an alien, hold %6$s to turn back.
Scan a creature (hold) to teach the band its alien.
